selection_rule: Choose baseline small-step, mild roughness and moderate-ramp candidates that passed all five screening repeats. Evaluate each on sixty new seeded initializations/layouts.
interpretation: Selected after screening, before holdout runs. Not a preregistered or exhaustive hardware validation study.
observed_guidance_correction: The original 20 observed-guidance trials aimed at the finish plane, stopping short by the follower tolerance. Retain them as superseded harness-development evidence. Rerun all four observed profiles with the goal 0.5 m beyond the same unchanged crossing plane.
threshold_policy: Keep dougie_terrain_protocol.json acceptance thresholds unchanged. Do not tune the walking policy using holdout outcomes.
